card.statement:
Suppose that $V(a_1,a_2,a_3)$ is torsion free.
The $A_2$-module $\hat{V}(a_1,a_2,a_3)$ decomposes into a direct sum of three torsion free submodules
$\hat{V}(a_1,a_2,a_3) = \hat{V}{(1)} \oplus \hat{V}{(2)} \oplus \hat{V}{(3)},$
where

$$\hat{V}{(m)}= \mbox{span}_{\mathbb C}\{{\mathbf v}_{i,3j+m,k}\,  | \, i,j,k \in \mathbb Z\}\simeq W=V( a^{(m)}_1, a^{(m)}_2, a_3, \frac{-8}{9}, \frac{8}{9})\, ,$$

$a^{(m)}_1=a_1-m$, $a^{(m)}_2=\frac{1}{2}(a_2-a_1)+m$, with $m=0,1,2$.
card.label: Theorem 26

paper.title: Gelfand-Tsetlin modules for Lie algebras of rank $2$
paper.abstract: We explicitly construct families of simple modules for Lie algebras of rank $2$, on which certain commutative subalgebra acts diagonally and has a simple spectrum. In type $A$ these modules are well known generic Gelfand-Tsetlin modules and they can be viewed as such for other rank $2$ Lie algebras.
